response.sql: WITH team_avg AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_rate FROM team_avg) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_rate AS diff_from_mean FROM team_avg t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_rate) IS NULL, diff_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Records with g = 0 are treated as missing win rates (division by zero yields NULL via NULLIF) and are ignored in the average, but still count toward the record count.
Record count is the total number of manager_half rows per team_id, including rows whose win rate is missing.
A team whose win rates are all missing is still listed, with a NULL average and difference, and sorts last.
